title: ci: pin the PR review to wachi-reviewer v1.2.0 instead of the floating v1
body:
## What this does

Pins the PR review to the exact engine release `v1.2.0` instead of the floating `v1`, and records the engine rename in ADR 0028 and the CI/CD page. Follow-up to #400, which moved `uses:` to `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`.

## Why

The engine's ADR 0001 (amended 2026-10-26) recommends exact tags: a moved `v1` would run a new release with this repository's key before anyone read it.

## What changes for you

- A new engine release runs here only after the tag in `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml` is edited. This repository has no Dependabot, so that is a manual edit.
- The header comment names the new `/wachi review` command; `@agent-review` and `@claude` still work.

## Proof

- `actionlint .github/workflows/agent-review.yml` → exit 0.
- Tag `v1.2.0` exists at `9528de1` and contains `DEFAULT_MENTION = "/wachi"`; `v1` points at the same commit today, so the engine code this PR runs is unchanged.
